form.changes: Muscles and supporting bones, cartilage, teeth and eye geometry selected. Nonselectable supporting structures combined; mapped muscle parts remain separate and named. Materials replaced, world scale centered to 2 units, geometry simplified with bounded error and locked borders, and Meshopt compressed. Inner-ear, kidney and other organ systems are excluded. A smooth, symmetrical whole-body deformation broadens the shoulder girdle and adds chest, upper-arm, thigh and calf volume. A relaxed A-pose opens the arms by 25 degrees and the legs by 10 degrees from the source stance. All tissues share the same deformation so muscle attachments and authored boundaries remain together. Head and foot shapes are preserved. This is a stylized fitness visualization, not a clinical anatomy reference.
